params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output '=== GH AUTH ==='; gh auth status; Write-Output '=== REPO ACTIONS PERMISSIONS ==='; gh api repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/permissions; Write-Output '=== HEAVEN BRIDGE RUNS ==='; gh run list --repo fengie/mhw-mods --workflow 'Heaven Local Bridge Gate' --limit 20 --json databaseId,name,workflowName,status,conclusion,event,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url; Write-Output '=== RECENT RUN JOBS ==='; $runsJson = gh run list --repo fengie/mhw-mods --workflow 'Heaven Local Bridge Gate' --limit 8 --json databaseId; $runs = $runsJson | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach($r in $runs){ Write-Output ('--- RUN ' + $r.databaseId + ' ---'); gh api ('repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/runs/' + $r.databaseId + '/jobs?filter=latest') }; Write-Output '=== BILLING USER ==='; gh api /users/fengie/settings/billing/actions; Write-Output '=== RUNNERS ==='; gh api repos/fengie/mhw-mods/actions/runners
